purpose: Final geometry, camera and visible material assessment of finished model-only paired colour and clay review artifacts against the previously inspected full original photographs06/33/55.
decision: Accept as identical-camera baseline/current review evidence with explicit residuals; photographic equivalence is not established.

sheet_composition_qa.result: Clean restrained labels; no clipping or image overlays. Each pair preserves equal-sized native full frames, with correct baseline/current labels.
sheet_composition_qa.encoding: JPEG quality94, 4:4:4; only final sheet encoding is lossy. Source PNGs remain unchanged.
sheet_composition_qa.colour_quality: 32-sample Cycles preview; clay uses Workbench studio rendering.

final_staging.basis: Movable photo33 staging differs from the plan and later principal photographs. Final chair/table ordering supersedes the earlier assessment of the far chair left of the table.

review_limits: This is a bounded review of principal06/principal33 artifacts, not full-house or surveyed architectural acceptance.
Source photographs use different dates, furniture arrangements and processing. Camera, geometry, material and illumination differences are not uniquely separable.
Workbench cavity/shadow rendering exaggerates fold relief and edge contrast; colour previews have finite sampling.
No new fitting, Blender rendering, source edit or camera-lock mutation was performed for this final assessment. Existing rendered inputs were assembled with Pillow.

views.assessment: Usable paired review. The corrected bed coverlet, south fanlight, west window and seating remain legible together; rear-headboard and close east-brace masks that invalidated earlier poses are absent.
improvements_visible: The plan-positioned bed and lower fanlight relationship are apparent with the frozen camera.
New paisley and softer red/cream curtain pattern are legible; timber is less dark and coarse than the baseline.
remaining_geometry_camera_differences: The pale upper gable infill and exposed rubble band over the west wall remain conspicuous. Original06 presents a more continuous warm plaster-to-roof relationship.
The fanlight is cropped at the left and its eastern curtain remains outside the frame. Original06 shows the inner arch between both curtain panels.
The bench is only a small fragment beside the bed. The coverlet dominates the lower foreground, with a different plain-linen, pillow and bench relationship.
The source foreground truss/timber framing is largely outside this camera; the model emphasizes the upper purlin/rafter band. Retained structure remains an unresolved camera/geometry relationship.
The west blind/window reads high relative to source seating and arch; its vertical dimensions remain inferred.
Coverlet folds remain larger and more regular than the source drape, although the colour pattern makes them less conspicuous than in clay.
remaining_material_light_differences: Floor and blind remain much paler than the warmer, darker originals; rendered wood remains comparatively uniform.
Curtain repeat remains more regular than the photographed ikat, and exposed cane/cushions are brighter than source.
views.residual_note: 84.34px architectural-point RMS at1200x900 is conditional camera-plus-geometry disagreement, not a score for furniture, fabric or roof resemblance.

views.assessment: Usable paired review. Both chairs and trumpet table are identifiable. Final movable staging puts the far chair back to the right/behind the table and the vessels left of it, correcting the earlier ordering discrepancy.
improvements_visible: Far chair is more exposed than in the rejected due-south pose and its staging order now follows source33.
Darker trumpet table, two visible vessels and softer red/cream curtain make the intended group clearer.
remaining_geometry_camera_differences: The retained foreground diagonal still has a broad projected face and masks much of the near chair back. Source33 leaves more of that back and surrounding floor visible.
The horizontal side member remains higher in the frame and has more perspective slope: underside approximatelyv0.25 against sourcev0.345.
The far chair back remains too high: the retained analytic back-top residual is approximately74px at900x1200. This was not resolved by moving the camera or changing chair height.
Less of the south fanlight appears at left, the right window is tightly cropped, and open floor around the near chair/brace remains narrower.
A cropped conical bedside-lamp fragment enters at lower left in the final colour frame; it is a remaining edge-staging difference without blocking the seating comparison.
Ceramic/branch and book arrangement remains approximate; branches are difficult to distinguish clearly at preview resolution.
remaining_material_light_differences: Far cane and cushions are much brighter and whiter than the muted warm cane and olive upholstery in the source.
Floor remains pale and the source broad warm shadow pattern is not matched. The table has improved dark patina but still lacks the source irregularity.
views.residual_note: No full two-dimensional landmark RMS exists. Table framing and prior vertical-only fits are conditional anchors, not proof of a recovered photographic camera.

acceptance_scope: Final image review recorded here separately from the frozen lock. Keep the identical lock for any further paired comparisons.
